attributes.title: SWPA 2027
attributes.summary:
The Southwestern Psychological Association meets from April 2 to 4, 2027, at the Royal Sonesta in Houston, Texas. Like the other regional psychological associations, SWPA runs a research-centered program of talks, posters, symposia and workshops, and it hosts four affiliate groups at the convention: SAMR, SWToP, Psi Chi and SCBNA.

SWPA folds membership dues into the registration fee, so every registrant becomes a member. Professionals who want continuing education credit register in a separate category, Professional Member Seeking CE Credits, at $250 through January 24, 2027, $275 through March 14 and $300 on site. The association's pages do not list the number of CE hours or the approving body, so licensed psychologists should confirm that the credit meets their board's rules.

The standard professional rate is $150 early, $175 online and $200 on site, and student members pay $80, $100 or $130. The call for submissions closes November 23, 2026. SWPA asks attendees to book at the Royal Sonesta to help meet its room commitment, and the hotel offers discounted self-parking for attendees.
